name: AetherBuilder
changelog: Fix: Add Section modal layout broken on InfinityFree/shared hosting due to CSS cache — all critical layout styles are now inline in JS (no longer depends on CSS file being fresh)
Fix: Filter pill active state now applied via inline style as well as CSS class (works on hosts with cached old CSS)
New: Real-time search & filter box in Add New Section modal — search by name, keyword, or category
New: Quick-filter pills in Add Section modal — All / Add-ons / Core Widgets tabs
New: Enter key selects first match; Escape clears search, second Escape closes modal
New: Mobile-friendly admin studio — slide-over drawer sidebar for phones and tablets
New: Mobile topbar toggle, FAB button, and backdrop overlay for sidebar on mobile
New: Built-in Chatbot Assistant quick-toggle in Add-ons panel header
New: Custom Live Chat Add-on (Tawk.to, Crisp, WhatsApp float, custom embed)
New: Contact & Hire Me Add-on (EmailJS, Viber, WhatsApp, Phone call)
New: Smart non-destructive addon merger on updates — user-created addons are preserved
UX: Create Add-On and Install buttons now sticky at top of Add-ons panel
UX: Inspector tabs bar now sticky when scrolling controls
UX: Repeater search/filter bar sticks flush below sticky inspector tabs
UX: Removed redundant floating Publish button — single Publish button in topbar
Fix: EmailJS fields moved to Advanced tab only in Contact addon
Fix: Viber deep-link corrected to viber://chat?number= mobile protocol
